column1: # Fold-aware equivalence metadata (bd 5jjn) in three classes, keyed by the
# classification column. An alias row is comparison metadata -- never a reason
# to invent a source class, duplicate an instantiation, or re-model a member.
# Every row is re-verified by `just template-alias-check`.
# MFC-TWIN-030): VC5 emits one copy of an MFC-template instantiation's
# out-of-line members per referencing TU; the copies differ only by relocations
# (call targets to twin helper copies, EH refs, data addresses). Verified:
#   - both addresses are sized functions in config/symbols.csv;
#   - curated names agree (same instantiation, not merely same shape);
#   - normalized instruction structure identical modulo relocations, with
# folded/aliased symbols -- the original address holds only a stale 5-byte jmp
# island whose chain (through ILT hops) lands on one shared final body owned by
# another symbol (e.g. many leaf-view dtors end at TView's 0x48a9d0). The
# island IS the folded symbol's canonical location; curated names within a
#   - alias bytes are a bare `jmp rel32` (+ nop/int3 padding when sized);
#   - the fold chain resolves exactly to the canonical address;
#   - the canonical is a sized function in config/symbols.csv.
# library_callee_alias: compiler wrappers that directly call a linked library
# body with the same decorated ABI identity. The wrapper remains a distinct
# report entity; this row canonicalizes only call operands. Verified:
#   - the wrapper has a direct call resolving to the canonical body;
#   - the row carries the canonical decorated library identity.
